title: New Apple TV 4K's A19 Chip Has One Core Switched Off
excerpt: Apple's new Apple TV 4K uses an A19 chip with one efficiency core disabled, according to system diagnostic data shared by code explorer pdfu....
content_html:
Monday November 16, 2026 3:43 am PST by Tim Hardwick

Apple's new Apple TV 4K uses an A19 chip with one efficiency core disabled, according to system diagnostic data shared by code explorer pdfu. That suggests a five-core CPU with two performance cores and three efficiency cores, compared with the six-core CPU in the iPhone 17.

The reported maximum clock speeds are 4.26GHz for performance cores and 2.592GHz for efficiency cores, with a five-core GPU reaching 1.47GHz. (These are maximum frequencies, not measurements of sustained performance.) Apple is likely using binned chips, where the disabled core is defective. The company used a similar configuration in the 2022 Apple TV 4K, whose A15 chip also had one CPU core disabled.

Thursday October 29, 2026 5:50 pm PDT by Joe Rossignol

Apple today released Xcode 27.2, and it reveals how much RAM is in the new fourth-generation Apple TV 4K and the new iPad mini with an OLED display. As expected, the new Apple TV 4K with the A19 chip is equipped with 8GB of RAM, while the new iPad mini with the A20 Pro chip has 12GB of RAM.
